summary: Binary-response commands (n8n-packages create, the package export) stamp the --dry-run JSON with a top-level action from the command's pp:method.
reason: handleBinaryResponseDelivery printed the client's bare {dry_run:true} sentinel, so the --dry-run --json contract (dry_run plus action) failed for binary endpoints. Generator template gap; fixed in the shared helper, not per command.
validated_outcome: n8n-pp-cli n8n-packages create --dry-run --json prints {"action":"post","dry_run":true}; live dogfood dry_run_json and json_fidelity rows pass.
